verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so this axis applies. However, the evidence only shows Adyen as infrastructure that lets external agents (Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) transact, plus an MCP server for use with the user's own LLM client. Neither is a built-in AI assistant inside the product to which a user can delegate tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
